commands:
nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '10000' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '10000' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '10000' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '10000' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'

<iptables> -N f2b-xinetd-fail
<iptables> -A f2b-xinetd-fail -j RETURN
<iptables> -I INPUT 1 -p tcp -m multiport --dports 0:65535 -j f2b-xinetd-fail
<iptables> -N f2b-xinetd-fail-log
<iptables> -I f2b-xinetd-fail-log -j LOG --log-prefix "$(expr f2b-xinetd-fail : '\(.\{1,23\}\)'):DROP " --log-level warning -m limit --limit 6/m --limit-burst 2
<iptables> -A f2b-xinetd-fail-log -j <blocktype>

<iptables> -D INPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 0:65535 -j f2b-xinetd-fail
<iptables> -F f2b-xinetd-fail
<iptables> -F f2b-xinetd-fail-log
<iptables> -X f2b-xinetd-fail
<iptables> -X f2b-xinetd-fail-log

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] xinetd-fail: started on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: root@localhost\n
Hi,\n
The jail xinetd-fail has been started successfully.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "root@localhost"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] xinetd-fail: stopped on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: root@localhost\n
Hi,\n
The jail xinetd-fail has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "root@localhost"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] xinetd-fail: banned <ip> from <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: root@localhost\n
Hi,\n
The IP <ip> has just been banned by Fail2Ban after
<failures> attempts against xinetd-fail.\n\n
Here is more information about <ip> :\n
`whois <ip> || echo "missing whois program"`\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "root@localhost"

nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '2222' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '2222' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '2222' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done

files.jail.local:
[webmin-auth]
enabled = true
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8
usedns = warn
[xinetd-fail]
enabled = true
action = %(action_mw)s
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=extra]
ignoreip = ::1 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.1.1
[directadmin]
enabled = true
